# OneSimpleSite

> OneSimpleSite provides web design and development for businesses across the UK. Fixed-price websites for local businesses such as plumbers, electricians, mechanics, cleaners, barbers, tutors, shops and builders. Work is done online.

## Key pages
- [Packages and prices](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/packages): Launch £189 and Growth £489, plus tailored quotations for Enterprise projects, with what each includes. Optional Hosting & Care at £29/month.
- [How it works](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/how-it-works): the process from brief to launch.
- [Web design by area](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/web-design): local pages for Hemel Hempstead, St Albans, Watford, London, Luton, Dunstable, Harpenden, Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City, Stevenage, Aylesbury and Milton Keynes.
- [Guides](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/guides): website builder or web designer, with notes on GoDaddy, One.com, Wix, Squarespace and WordPress.
- [FAQ](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/faq)
- [Contact](https://onesimplesite.co.uk/contact)

## Notes
- Prices and delivery estimates are on the packages page. Delivery is an estimate counted from when the agreed information, assets, account access and initial payment are received.
- OneSimpleSite is independent and not affiliated with the platforms named in its guides.
